guidance.bestFor: A single revenue series as solid bars over 12 months with horizontal grid lines and a dollar amount in the tooltip

guidance.bestFor: A pair of series in the same color told apart by fill, a dotted texture for desktop and solid bars for mobile

guidance.bestFor: Visits from 5 traffic sources as rounded donut slices with gradient fills and a drop shadow, totaled in thousands at the center
agentNotes: Slices fill from per source defs such as `gradient-direct` that hardcode chart colors, so a new `source` needs its own gradient

whenNotToUse.when: A center figure that is a completion percent rather than a sum
